faq.answer: Each scholarship listing includes its own deadline, so it's important to check each one individually. Many of the deadlines are approaching within the next 45 days, so reviewing them promptly is advisable.

faq.answer: Award sizes for the scholarships listed vary significantly, with amounts ranging approximately from $500 to $16,000. Be sure to look at each individual listing for specific details.
